description: Vercel AI SDK v6 structured object generation through OpenAI chat.
notes: generateObject is deprecated in ai 6.0.322, so the call is generateText with Output.object and a jsonSchema. Telemetry is enabled through experimental_telemetry. recordInputs and recordOutputs stay at their defaults. The model is openai.chat, and the SDK makes one call. The span name is ai.generateText. Token counts are copied: input 24 and output 10, with inputTokenDetails present. ai.response.timestamp is the mock created_at, 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z.
